leadText:
Phil (Japanese: ゼン Zen) and Mayshure (Japanese: リョク Ryoku), collectively referred to as the All-Out Brothers (Japanese: ゼンリョク兄弟 Zenryoku Brothers), are characters of the day who appeared in All Out, All of the Time!.

They signed up for the Pokémon Catch Adventure Race race and met and Goh. Recognizing Ash as Alola's first ever , they posed for pictures with Ash before taking part in the race.

During the race, they rode together on Phil's and came across a boulder blocking the path. They attempted to have Kommo-o use on the boulder but the move failed, causing it to start rolling down the path before being stopped by Goh's Boldore.

Later, they came across a lake where they had to catch themselves a , which they attempted to do with another Clangorous Soulblaze, which failed. They later met up with Ash and Goh as they attempted to catch a but their efforts were stopped by who caught the Passimian, , and . Phil and Mayshure were able to pull off a Clangorous Soulblaze and sent Team Rocket blasting off. After catching a Passimian, they raced to the finish line, only to come second behind Ash and Goh and received a runner up prize.
